title: Array Representation & Indexing
markdown:
Stored in a 0-based sequential array without explicit node pointers.

- $\text{parent}(i) = \lfloor (i - 1) / 2 \rfloor$
- $\text{leftChild}(i) = 2i + 1$
- $\text{rightChild}(i) = 2i + 2$

**Properties**
- Node exists if and only if $\text{index} < n$ (heap size).
- Tree height grows logarithmically: $h = \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor$.
- Root-to-leaf path length is $O(\log n)$.
